method: Inspect harness runSelector (allowlist + private block), all 60 selector run oracle_access/process_role flags and read_logs, SELECTIONS_FREEZE ordering, EVALUATOR_READ_LOGS.

residual_note.impact: Evidence of zero private reads is by-construction, not by runtime instrumentation.
residual_note.observation: Each selector run's read_log is a STATIC declared array, not a runtime-instrumented capture of fs reads (unlike execution-001's trackedRead). Isolation is nonetheless enforced structurally by the allowlist/private-block in code and by the fact that createSelection only reads public inputs.

selector_code_guard: runSelector enforces PUBLIC_READ_MANIFEST allowlist and throws READ_BLOCKED on any path containing 'private'; selector never opens private/.
